jobs.title: Manager, Clinical Laboratory
jobs.description_text: POSITION SUMMARY: The Manager, Clinical Lab is a key leader in Natera’s lab operations who oversees and directs the development, planning, implementation and maintenance of manufacturing methods, processes and operations for new or existing products and technologies. The Manager works closely with groups to ensure strict compliance with good manufacturing practices and CLIA/CAP guidelines at all times. Ensures the effective use of materials, equipment and employees in producing quality products. Monitor and control staffing / labor, capital expenditures, and manufacturing performance. Develops budget and monitors expenditures. Formulates and recommends manufacturing policies, procedures and programs. Selects, develops and evaluates line-management to ensure the efficient operation of the function. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES: Under the direction of Senior lab leadership, and in close collaboration with other Laboratory leadership, this individual provides operational and strategic leadership to laboratory products assigned to the individual. Generates and routinely provides executive-level production/departmental summaries. Monitors workflow and ensures production goals and deadlines are met (e.g. TAT, SLA) Engages in future planning and scales employees and equipment appropriately Gathers and monitors metrics on production deadlines, efficiency, scrap waste, and error rates Monitors the quality control/assurance programs, test results, and equipment (if applicable) Uses metrics

jobs.title: Organ Health Specialist
jobs.description_text: Location: The territory for this position includes Boston, MA and Rhode Island. We are seeking an experienced Organ Health Specialist (OHS) to join our growing Organ Health sales team! In this role, you will drive revenue growth and market development within the nephrology and transplant markets by cultivating and maintaining key relationships, executing strategic business plans, and promoting the adoption of both existing and newly launched products. Your expertise and insights will play a critical role in advancing our mission to support healthcare providers with innovative diagnostic tools. The ideal candidate is a results-driven professional with a proactive mindset, adept at navigating complex sales environments and overcoming challenges. If you're passionate about improving chronic kidney disease patient care and excel in a fast-paced, competitive sales environment, we encourage you to apply. Responsibilities As an Organ Health Specialist, you will promote and sell Renasight , a genetic test designed to identify potential genetic causes of kidney disease and assess hereditary risks based on family history. Renasight analyzes 397 genes associated with chronic kidney disease (CKD), providing critical insights for patient care and management. In addition to Renasight, you will also sell Prospera , a genetic test for organ transplant that detects otherwise undetected rejection events, helping to prevent potential loss of a transplanted organ. Achieve and exceed performance

jobs.title: Scientist R&D – Immunohistochemistry (IHC) & Histology
jobs.description_text: POSITION SUMMARY Natera is seeking a highly motivated Scientist, R&D – Immunohistochemistry (IHC) & Histology to join the Oncology Product Development team. This role will focus on the development, optimization, verification, and validation of IHC and tissue-based workflows supporting oncology products and clinical assay development. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in IHC assay development and optimization, supported by a solid foundation in histology and FFPE tissue workflows. Experience with automated IHC/ISH staining platforms, particularly the Roche BenchMark ULTRA IHC/ISH System, is highly desirable. Experience with NGS and molecular biology workflows is an additional plus. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES Design and execute development, optimization, verification, and validation studies for IHC, histology, and tissue-based workflows. Develop and optimize IHC assays, including antibody selection and titration, antigen retrieval, staining conditions, controls, and assay performance assessment. Evaluate and optimize histology and pre-analytical variables, including tissue fixation, FFPE processing, embedding, sectioning, H&E staining, and slide preparation. Develop and troubleshoot workflows on automated IHC/ISH staining platforms and investigate staining artifacts, reagent performance, tissue quality, and assay variability. Plan and execute moderate- to high-complexity experiments; analyze and interpret results using tools such as Excel, JMP, and image-an

jobs.title: In Office RN- NY Licensed
jobs.description_text: The Opportunity Our New York in-office RNs work collaboratively with one another and with every member of their office-based care team. With continuous access to support from our Virtual Medical Team, we provide accessible, comprehensive, and coordinated care grounded in longitudinal, healing relationships. As a Registered Nurse, you’ll report to the RN Manager based off your specific region of New York and play a critical role in delivering high-quality primary care. Your responsibilities center on clinical nursing care, patient education, care coordination, and continuous clinical excellence across the lifespan. In New York, the RN is an essential member of the care team, helping ensure care is delivered safely and effectively in accordance with applicable nursing regulations, scope-of-practice requirements, and clinical guidelines. Our clinics provide broad, comprehensive primary care, and the RN plays a key role in bringing this model to life - supporting patients, partnering closely with providers, and ensuring continuity and coordination across the care journey.
